game.title: Death Stranding
game.blurb: Open-world delivery action-adventure from Kojima Productions, released 2019-11-08 (the Steam app is the Director's Cut). RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Sam's journey east to west, reconnecting America episode by episode. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Deliveries and Porter Grades
chapters.summary: Standard and premium orders, lost cargo, cargo weight and distance, and porter grades.

chapters.title: Building and the Network
chapters.summary: Structures, roads, upgrades, facility connections, Bridge Links, supply requests, bots, shout-outs and fabrication.

chapters.title: BB, BTs and Life on the Road
chapters.summary: Caring for BB, sneaking past BTs, Catchers, resting, footwear, mail and interviews.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1850570)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Death_Stranding
Fandom (deathstranding.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://deathstranding.fandom.com/wiki/Death_Stranding
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). The Steam app used is the Director's Cut (1850570), the only Death Stranding 1 entry in the Steam store list; its schema calls the app "Project Lake" (an internal codename). RAWG's first hit matched the expected entry death-stranding (id 50738, the 2019 release); RAWG also lists a separate Director's Cut entry. StrategyWiki has a page (no completion stage in its page data); the Walkthrough and its Prologue and Episode 1 to 15 subpages are linked but not written (only Controls, Skills and Table of Contents exist), so no structure was taken beyond noting the game is split into a prologue and 15 episodes. deathstranding.fandom.com answers the API, with about 53 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 31 of 63 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the main story chapter. About 15 have unlock rates of 20 to 93 percent and read as story beats; the rest (such as "Like and Be Liked", "Chiral Crafter", "Soak and Sigh", "Fount of Knowledge" at 2.9%) are probably optional and need sorting.
